name: Multi-View Semantic Segmentation Strategy
definition: A flexible pipeline step to enable open-vocabulary querying and interactive scene editing by segmenting multi-view images, where each segmented object corresponds to an independent iVR-GS model.
summary: Multi-View Semantic Segmentation Strategy trains independent 3D Gaussian Splatting models from segmented multi-view images, enabling open-vocabulary querying while avoiding modifications to the underlying Gaussian structure.
